summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing the final result of Poste Italiane S.p.A.'s voluntary public tender and exchange offer for Telecom Italia S.p.A. ordinary shares, in which TIM is a minority holder. Poste reached approximately 85.823% (1,832,941,911 shares) via the offer, later lifting its stake to roughly 86.952% (1,857,060,167 shares) through on-market purchases settled around October 2, 2026. TIM provides no board recommendation; watch Poste consolidation, minority treatment, remaining float, and any follow-on mandatory offer implications.
